oauth.wants: {client} wants to use {app} on your behalf, with your account.
oauth.unverified: That name was given by the application itself: trust where you go back to, just below.
oauth.returnTo: When you accept you will go back to {host}.
oauth.loopback: It goes back to a program on this same computer. Accept only if you have just connected one yourself.
oauth.goBack: Go back to the application that brought you here and try again.
oauth.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a while.
oauth.error.client_missing: The application didn’t say who it is (client_id is missing).
oauth.error.client_unknown: This application is not registered here.
oauth.error.client_document_url: The application’s identifier is not a valid address.
oauth.error.client_document_https: The application’s details must be served over https.
oauth.error.client_document_ip: The application’s details can’t be at an IP address.
oauth.error.client_document_private: The application’s details are not at a public address.
oauth.error.client_document_unreachable: The application’s details couldn’t be read.
oauth.error.client_document_invalid: The application’s details are not valid.
oauth.error.client_document_mismatch: The application’s details don’t match its identifier.
oauth.error.redirect_not_registered: The return address is not registered for this application.
oauth.error.request_expired: The request has expired. Try again from the application.
